# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for CocinaP. Do not publish proof of
concepts, credentials, personal data or exploit details in public issues.

If private reporting is not enabled yet, contact the repository owner privately
through the email listed in the repository profile.

## Response targets

| Phase | Target |
|---|---|
| Initial acknowledgement | 48 hours |
| Impact assessment | 7 days |
| Fix development | 1-2 weeks |
| Release and notification | Coordinated with reporter |

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the current maintained release line. Older releases should
be upgraded after reviewing the release notes.
